summary: Frontend testing at 375x667 Expo web, plus a short API sanity suite (5/5 pass). ALL requested flows PASS: (1) Employee Forms lists 6 Week Check-in and 3/6/12 Month Review under HR, and Task Creation & Management is hidden. (2) Admin Forms has a SUPPORT OFFICE section with 'Task Creation & Management' (audience label Support Office, url .../task-creation--management-form, audiences [support_office]). (3) The form audience picker and the Team directory group picker both list New Starter Employees / New Starter Contractors. (4) Compose task shows 'Attachment (optional)' and 'Upload a file'. Picking /tmp/cpd.png shows the file name and remove X, and remove/re-add works. Saved as 'Just me' (admin) and as a private task (employee), the task row shows the cpd.png paperclip link, which opens /api/tasks/files/{id}?token= (200 image/png) without toggling the task. (5) Regression: opening upload-certificate directly by URL and uploading lands on Certificates with no GO_BACK error. Company Drive shows the 'Therapist' / 'Participants' buttons in full. Deleting a certificate also removes its linked CPD log (API check). No page errors, no red screens, no deprecated Expo packages in the files reviewed.

minor.issue: Uploaded files that never get attached to a task (user cancels, or POST /api/tasks fails after the upload) stay in task_files and object storage as orphans. There is no cleanup.
The session token is passed in the URL query. It ends up in browser history and proxy logs. This pattern was already used for Drive; consider short-lived signed URLs.

ui_bugs.issue: uploadForm() / up.json() at compose.tsx:100 is not inside try/finally. If the network request throws, saving stays true, the button spins forever and no error is shown. Move the upload inside the existing try block.

issues: At 375x667 the 8th row 'New Starter Contractors' sits under the Save button until the user scrolls the list. The list scrolls correctly, but nothing shows that more options exist. Consider a max-height list with a fade or scroll indicator.
The task-attachment Pressable is 32px tall (hitSlop 6 brings it to about 44). Acceptable, but on the small side.

action_items: (LOW) compose.tsx:97-107: wrap the task attachment upload in try/finally so saving is reset if the network request throws.
(LOW) Optional: clean up orphaned task_files (uploaded but never attached).

(INFO) Drive spaces therapist/participant currently have folder_id null in /integrations/google-drive/status, so Company Drive shows 'Therapist Resources isn't set up yet'. Re-select the folders in Integrations if they were meant to be configured.

task_file access: admin, uploader or task assignee. Correct, and an employee cannot attach another user's file (404 verified).

Real staff groups were not changed (picker opened then cancelled). Uploaded TEST_iter13_cert and TEST_iter13_cpdcert (soft-deleted) may have copies in the real Google Drive 'StaffHub Certificates' folder, so the main agent should trash them.

Web bypass: localStorage auth_token = JSON.stringify('test_session_admin'|'test_session_employee').
